content.text:
I'm not sure the robot ended up facing the ball. It is close, but I may have nudged it, and I called rest anyway.

The last walk toward the ball stopped on a foot-bumper event. The camera image just before that showed the ball a short way ahead and slightly left. The robot may have touched it.

The last image, taken as the robot crouched, shows the ball at the far left edge of the top camera. It looks like it rolled or ended up to the left of where the robot is pointing.

The robot is now crouched with its motors off. If you want it facing the ball, I can stand it back up and turn it left a little.
